captions.linkedin:
Larry Williams won the 1987 World Cup of Futures Trading using this exact COT logic. Most retail traders never read a single CFTC report.

The edge isn't a secret. It's just slow, weekly data nobody wants to wait for.

Here's the complete logic. No black box:

🔹 COMMERCIALS INDEX. Normalize weekly hedger net position to a 156-week historic range.
🔹 MOMENTUM TRIGGER. Williams %R turning near 80 or 20 fires the entry inside the favorable COT condition.
🔹 MULTI-MARKET. Any futures market with CFTC COT report coverage qualifies.
🔹 WEEKLY CONDITION. COT condition resets Friday on report release, not intraday.
🔹 STOP DISCIPLINE. Hard stops beyond recent swing keep one bad print from breaking the account.

Based on Larry Williams' COT materials. CFTC data is official, but the effect remains contested in modern markets. You verify it yourself.
